Name: Maaseiah, Governor of the City
Summary: Maaseiah, governor of the city, was sent by Josiah with Shaphan and Joah to repair the house of the LORD.
KeyStory: Josiah sent Shaphan, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Shaphan, Son of Azaliah
LifeLesson: City government joined the work of repairing God's house.
